bench.workbench.selectProject.zh: 选择一个项目以查看工作台
bench.workbench.selectProject.en: Select a project to see the workbench

bench.workbench.openFolderHint.zh: 在文件管理器中打开项目文件夹
bench.workbench.openFolderHint.en: Open the project folder in your file manager

bench.workbench.noFiles.zh: 还没有文件 — 先选择一个文件夹开始
bench.workbench.noFiles.en: No files yet — pick a folder to start

bench.workbench.entriesHint.zh: {n} 个条目 · 点击文件查看 diff
bench.workbench.entriesHint.en: {n} entries · click a file to view diff

bench.workbench.binaryPreview.zh: [二进制文件，{size} 字节 — 预览已禁用]

bench.workbench.snapshotDone.zh: 快照 {id}：{count} 个文件（{bytes} 字节）

bench.workbench.restoreTitle.zh: 从最新检查点恢复所有文件？
bench.workbench.restoreTitle.en: Restore all files from latest checkpoint?

bench.workbench.restoreContent.zh: 这会覆盖 agent 自上次快照以来修改过的所有文件。
bench.workbench.restoreContent.en: This will overwrite any files the agent has changed since the last snapshot.

bench.workbench.restoreDone.zh: 已从检查点恢复 {n} 个文件。

bench.workbench.changedCount.zh: 自上次检查点以来有 {n} 个文件发生变更
bench.workbench.changedCount.en: {n} changed files since the last checkpoint

bench.workbench.noChanges.zh: 暂无变更 — agent 还没有修改任何文件
bench.workbench.noChanges.en: No changes — agent hasn't modified any files yet

bench.workbench.noTasks.zh: 还没有任务 — 启动一次 Loop 查看进度
bench.workbench.noTasks.en: No tasks yet — start a loop to see progress

bench.workbench.deliverablesHint.zh: agent 创建或修改过的文件 — 点击名称查看内容。
bench.workbench.deliverablesHint.en: Files the agent has created or modified — click a name to view its content.

bench.workbench.noDeliverables.zh: 还没有交付物 — 先创建快照开始跟踪
bench.workbench.noDeliverables.en: No deliverables yet — take a snapshot to start tracking

plan.empty.zh: 还没有计划 — Coder 启动后会生成。
plan.empty.en: No plan yet — the Coder will emit one when it starts.
